REPLACEMENT CONDITION 5 - Maximum/ minimum quantum of non-residential floorspaceNo more and no less than the following quantities of non-residential floorspace shall be constructed on the site (GEA sqm):o 885 sqm flexible commercial floorspace (Use Class E a, b, c, g)o 600 sqm community health centre Use Class E (e)o 750 sqm leisure space Use Class E (d)Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any Order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), the non-residential floorspace identified on drawings ref. LD506-HTA-B-00-DR-A-07-2000 P04, LD506-HTA-C-00-DR-A-07-4000 P01 , LD507-2229-RMA-D-00-DR-A-07-1400 Rev P8 shall only be used for purposes under the respective Use Classes indicated on the drawings and corresponding to the use classes of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) (Amendment) (England) Regulations 2020 and for no other purpose.Reason: The commercial space allocated on the site will support the emerging town centre, bring jobs and animate the public realm.  Conversion from Use Class E to Use Class C3 under permitted development is restricted.

REPLACEMENT CONDITION 13 - Fire Strategy ComplianceDevelopment shall be built out strictly in accordance with the following approved Fire Strategies:- Meridian Water Phase 1B Revised Planning Fire Statement 0052221, 21 February 2023, prepared by Buro Happold.- Meridian Waters Phase 1B - Plot D London Plan Fire Statement XXXX-BHE-XX-XX-XX-YD-0002 0052221 Revision P01, 7 August 2025 by Bruro Happold- Meridian Waters Phase 1B - Plot C1 London Plan Fire Statement XXXX-BHE-XX-XX-XX-YD-0001 0052221 Revision P01, 5 August 2025 by Bruro HappoldReason: To accord with London Plan Policy D12.

REPLACEMENT CONDITION 52 - Details of Plot D tower crownPrior to any superstructure works on Plot D, detailed drawings to a scale of 1:20 of the proposed Plot D tower crown as shown on LD507-2229-RMA-D-RF-DR-A-07-1406 Rev P6, LD507-2229-RMA-D-XX-DR-A-08-2750 Rev P3, LD507-2229-RMA-D-XX-DR-A-08-2751 Rev P3,LD507-2229-RMA-D-XX-DR-A-08-2752 Rev P3, LD507-2229-RMA-D-XX-DR-A-08-2753 Rev P3, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Details shall include details of materials, external finish and lighting. The Plot D tower crown shall be constructed in accordance with the  approved details.Reason: To ensure a high quality design in accordance with policy D4 of the London Plan, CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and DMD37 of the Enfield Development Management Policy (2014).

REPLACEMENT CONDITION 59 - Environmental Statement and identified mitigation complianceThe development shall be undertaken in accordance with the Iceni Energist Environmental Statement dated December 2021, Supplementary Environmental Statement dated April 2022 and Meridian Water Phase 1B - Environmental Statement of Conformity, dated July 2025, prepared by Iceni and shall be carried out in accordance with the mitigation measures set out in Table 14.2 and Table 14.3 of the December 2021 ES unless otherwise provided for in the Supplementary Environmental Statement and Statement of Conformity.Reason: To ensure the development is undertaken in accordance with the Environmental Statement submitted and all measures identified therein to mitigate the impact of the development on the environment are fully complied with.
